title: Collaborative Large Language Models and Sequential Recommendation Models for Device-Cloud Recommendation

problem.claim: LLM4Rec has limited practical applicability because it cannot adequately capture real-time user preferences.

gap.claim: Frequent training and inference costs, difficulty accessing real-time data, and deployment constraints on devices limit LLM4Rec.

narrative_sequence.summary: LLM4Rec is presented as a promising direction with strong performance.
LLM4Rec is limited in practical settings by weak real-time preference capture and resource and deployment constraints.
Small recommendation models are presented as able to address these limitations through low-resource frequent updates and device-side access to real-time data.

source_observation.claim: Models with different resource and data-access profiles can complement one another in recommendation systems.

interpretation.claim: A device-cloud division may combine broad model capability with local real-time responsiveness.

application.claim: Use a resource-intensive model for capabilities that benefit from scale and a lightweight device-side model for frequent updates and real-time data.

exception.claim: The supplied units do not establish that this division improves recommendation quality or deployment outcomes.

unknowns: The proposed collaborative method is not described.
No datasets, baselines, metrics, or experimental results are supplied.
No details are supplied about training, inference, communication, or device-cloud deployment.
